Dialogs.Dialog: Will you solve this problem with me？
You're so cool when you're full of confidence. You worked really hard, after all.
I want us to do our best together, so from now on too... let me stay by your side. Just kidding.
Hey, the results of the math quiz――
Hehe. Looks like it went well？
Nailed it！ All thanks to ▲高嶺＊＊▲ teaching me so much！
I had a feeling you'd get a good result, so I'm happy.
What made you think I'd do well？
You answered my questions so smoothly, and you worked so hard...
...I thought, that's the person I love, after all...
Ah, oh no, I... um, so... let's do our best next time too？
How do you come up with solutions that surprise even the teacher？
Oh, that. I came up with it during preparation.
That's the result of your everyday effort. Amazing. I want to learn from you.
You too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！ I was just following ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s example.
Hehe！ But it's a little funny. Both of us learning from each other.
Right. ...From now on too, let's keep learning from each other and doing our best？
(All right, no slacking, let's do our best！)
So that's how you solve it. I see～. All right, next problem！
Nothing. You've looked like you're having so much fun studying lately.
I've been doing well too. Maybe because you're with me.
When ▲高嶺＊＊▲ says that, it makes me want to try even harder.
Same here. If you say that to me, I'll try hard too.
Maybe we'll just keep pushing ourselves like this forever.
Of course！ Because... we'll always be together, right？
That really hard problem. Apparently you were the only one who solved it.
So that means ▲高嶺＊＊▲ didn't either？
Right. You can brag, you know？ Just kidding.
Haha！ But if I bragged, they'd give me even harder ones, so I'll pass...
But the way you are now, it seems like you could really solve any problem.
Maybe I'll go brag for you？ ...Just kidding.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Um... why are you mad？
You studied hard all by yourself.
Yeah. I want to be a guy who's worthy of ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Well done. Next time, I'm joining you, okay？
You were the center of attention, huh？ Everyone said your interpretation was really sharp.
That's not even enough, you know？ Really and truly.
When you say that, it makes me feel like I have to keep working hard.
Really？ Then I'll praise you even more！ Okay？
You're really wonderful when you're working hard, you know. Just kidding▼
(I'll keep doing my best after all！)
I couldn't concentrate on today's class. It's your fault, you know？
You got called on to read aloud, right？
You read so smoothly, and your voice was lovely... I couldn't stop staring.
You are!! That's how you look to me.
Your essay is getting a great reputation.
I'm glad I put effort into it.
Hehe. I became one of your fans too▼
I'll keep cheering you on with all I've got. Hehe！
You're on fire, ▲主人公＊▲. I wish you'd share some.
Yes. Reading comprehension, a sense for interpretation, memory, and...
It's not that it's no good！
I don't want the results of your hard work, I want to learn from how hard you work.
You look so cool when you're focused... so keep it up, okay？
I want to learn from your sense.
I still have a long way to go, but thank you.
You make such wonderful works, and you still have a long way to go？
I love that part of you too...
Hm？ Didn't catch that, one more time！
That's not a sense you need to polish. ...Geez.
Wow... hey, did you make that？
I just think it's wonderful. I'd even want to display it in my room.
Yes. Look, everyone's looking at it.
...Maybe I should hide it？ Along with you.
Your work and you, all to myself. Just kidding.
Your recent work is wonderful. Looking at it warms my heart...
Hearing ▲高嶺＊＊▲ say that makes all the effort worth it.
Hehe. Flattery won't get you anything.
But I really do think it's wonderful...
I want you to show me more. From now on, always.
I love the pictures you've been drawing lately.
Hehe, seriously. No flattery, no favoritism.
They're gentle, and the way you use color is so...
More than any grade, those words make me happy.
Yeah, really. So feel free to praise me more, you know？
▲主人公＊▲. I saw your painting？ It's amazing.
Hey... what does it take to create something that wonderful？
How can effort make it better？ Artistic sense, I mean.
How!? ...You want to know that badly？
It might be something you're born with, but if there's a way to improve it...
Fine. In that case, I'll just stick to you like glue.
(I have to do my best next time！)
They say lots of people are moved by your singing voice？
Of course. Everyone else is enchanted, too.
Honestly, I'd like to keep it all to myself...
But I also want to brag a little... so keep it up, okay？
Lately, your playing has a mysterious feel to it.
Yes. The sound is so clear... it makes me want to hear it over and over.
Yep. We'll reserve the music room！
Hehe！ If that happens, should I play the piano too？
(I sang my heart out this time！)
You sang like you were having so much fun, even the teacher was smiling！
It made me realize music really is about "enjoying sound."
Did I look like I was having that much fun？
I wonder if it feels good because I'm singing with you.
(Let's keep it up next time too！)
Amazing. Your knowledge of music seems to keep growing.
I get to hear about Chopin and all kinds of composers, so it's really fun.
I'd better work hard, or I'll get left behind.
I am your senior when it comes to music, after all.
In music class, you look like you're having so much fun that it rubs off on me.
And seeing ▲高嶺＊＊▲ like that rubs off on me, so it gets even more fun.
And then results follow. That's really ideal.
Feels like that happens a lot. When I'm with ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
I also want to do my best because I have you...
Hehe. Let's keep going like this. Do our best？
When you're singing, people often tell me I have a really nice look on my face.
"Isn't he wonderful？ He's my boyfriend, and I'm so proud！"
...is written all over my face, they say. That I look so happy.
It's a little embarrassing... but it just happens.
It's your fault, you know. Just kidding.
(That's embarrassing... but I'm glad I worked hard！)
You've been amazing lately. Great times in both sprints and long distance.
Thanks, maybe I'm on a roll！
Yes. You looked so cool running, too. Really wonderful――
Sorry, didn't catch that, one more time！
(All right, let's do our best next time too！)
Ah... um. You look so light on your feet, I figured you're in good shape.
Maybe my daily efforts are paying off！
You're wonderful when you're on the court, but
even just being normal like this, you're wonderful.
Sorry. I can't help being conscious of you...
Please tell us how it feels to break record after record.
I still have a long way to go, so I want to aim even higher！
Still a long way to go？
Then I'll hold off on my gold medal for you a while longer, okay？
I hereby present you with the Great Effort Award.
Keep training hard without getting hurt, okay▼
(All right, I'll do my best next time too！)
(I really nailed my workouts this time！)
Yo. Hehe！ You're on fire, huh？
I'm secretly proud of you too. Just kidding.
No need to keep it secret, you can be proud out in the open！
Tell me if you get worn out？ I'll give you a massage. Okay？
What's up？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲... you're spacing out.
Ah, sorry. Um... I was just thinking how strong you've gotten...
And that's making my heart race a little...
...Yes. If you get close, you might hear my heartbeat...
(...All right, I'll work hard and get even stronger！)
Good work, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. ...Hm？ You look happy.
Yes. Because you've been doing so great.
I know how hard you're working... so it makes me really happy.
Yes. I bet you'll get good results in matches too.
Hehe, yes. I'll do my best▼
You beat Captain Tezuka in a rally, after all. Of course you're tired.
Everyone said you're amazing？ They want to use your practice as a model.
But I still can't really match him.
Then let's work on that？ I'll help too. Okay？
▲主人公＊▲. Did you already finish cleaning up？
I knew it. I wish I had come a little earlier.
Hehe, geez. If it's a cleaning competition, I won't lose next time.
Maybe I'll have you help next time. Shall we head home？
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, why did you move forward in that situation？
Hmm. My body just moved on its own！ Just kidding.
Hehe. It's not "just kidding," it's really true, isn't it？
You practice with so much focus... of course it shows in your play.
Lately, you've had so many impressive moments, and I...
(Yeah, let's do our best next time too！)
Your form... it's gotten even cleaner, huh？
Yes. Even Suzuki-sensei was praising it.
"Never forget your beginner's spirit," right. I'll go back to basics too.
Really？ Then maybe I'll... take you up on it？
Hehe, I know. I'm in your hands, Coach▼
(First place in the mixed relay. I wonder if ▲高嶺＊＊▲ was watching～)
You know. When you crossed the finish line first...
Oh, it's fine. It was just a little embarrassing...
More importantly, congrats. First place. You looked so cool▼
Um. Well... you looked cool swimming.
I'm kind of nervous. Maybe because you're not wearing clothes. You look so big.
Yes. ...Hehe. But you're cool even when you're not swimming▼
